label: Path Traversal (Syscall)
title: Prefix-Bypass Directory Traversal in Syscall Router
description: Syscall path validator checks root prefix without normalizing ".." segments or null-byte sequences, allowing escape to /etc/shadow.

label: Slab OOM Exhaustion (Memory)
title: Missing Slab Cap & Negative Integer Bypass in Memory Allocator
description: Allocator accepts arbitrary byte counts and negative integers without checking per-slab caps or total heap quota, crashing kernel space.

label: SYN / Burst Flood (Firewall)
title: Unthrottled Packet Burst & Oversized MTU Acceptance
description: Ingress filter fails to enforce per-source rate limits and accepts oversized frames, saturating NIC ring buffers.

label: Privilege Escalation (Auth)
title: Non-Constant-Time Check & Guest Role Fallback Bypass
description: Auth vault uses short-circuit string equality susceptible to timing side-channels and permits unvalidated role elevation.

label: Circular Deadlock (Scheduler)
title: Self-Referential Task Dependency & Queue Overflow
description: Scheduler enqueues tasks with circular dependencies and exceeds ring buffer capacity, stalling kernel worker threads.
